name: The Seeker
summary:
The Seeker represents a virtual world capable of completely immersing the user in Venetian nature, stimulating the mind and curiosity. In particular it will be possible:
  
a) move within a lush and evocative forest
b) access many enchanting naturalistic scenarios, such as the clearing, the waterfalls, the tree house, a mountain hut and much more
c) carry out stimulating cognitive activities to search for the mysterious treasure
